name: Employee
description: An employee of the QuickBooks company.

update.note: Sparse update; body must include Id and SyncToken.

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for this object. Sort order is ASC by default. System-generated and required for update/get operations.

fields.name: SyncToken
fields.description: Version number of the object. Required for update operations to provide optimistic locking; the latest value must be supplied.

fields.name: DisplayName
fields.description: The name of the employee as displayed. Must be unique across all Customer, Vendor, and Employee objects. If not supplied, it is derived from name components (GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, Suffix). Maximum 500 characters.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Title of the person. Examples: Mr., Mrs., Dr. Maximum 16 characters. Part of the name; not derived from DisplayName.

fields.name: GivenName
fields.description: Given (first) name of the employee. Maximum 100 characters. At least one of Title, GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, or Suffix is required.

fields.name: MiddleName
fields.description: Middle name of the employee. The person can have zero or more middle names. Maximum 100 characters.

fields.name: FamilyName
fields.description: Family (last) name of the employee. Maximum 100 characters.

fields.name: Suffix
fields.description: Suffix appended to the name of the employee. Example: Jr. Maximum 16 characters.

fields.name: PrintOnCheckName
fields.description: Name of the employee as printed on a check. If not provided, it is populated from DisplayName. Maximum 100 characters.

fields.name: Active
fields.description: If true, this entity is currently enabled for use by QuickBooks. The default value is true.

fields.name: PrimaryAddr
fields.description: Primary physical address of the employee. PhysicalAddress structure.

attributes.name: Id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the address object within the object it is referenced from. Read-only and system-defined.

attributes.name: Line1
attributes.description: First line of the address. Maximum 500 characters.

attributes.name: Line2
attributes.description: Second line of the address. Maximum 500 characters.

attributes.name: Line3
attributes.description: Third line of the address. Maximum 500 characters.

attributes.name: Line4
attributes.description: Fourth line of the address. Maximum 500 characters.

attributes.name: Line5
attributes.description: Fifth line of the address. Maximum 500 characters.

attributes.name: CountrySubDivisionCode
attributes.description: Region within a country, such as state in the USA or province in Canada. Maximum 255 characters.

attributes.name: Lat
attributes.description: Latitude coordinate of the geocoded address. Returned only if the address has been geocoded.

attributes.name: Long
attributes.description: Longitude coordinate of the geocoded address. Returned only if the address has been geocoded.

fields.name: PrimaryEmailAddr
fields.description: Primary email address of the employee. EmailAddress structure.

attributes.name: Address
attributes.description: An email address. The maximum length is 100 characters. Must be a valid email format.

fields.name: PrimaryPhone
fields.description: Primary phone number of the employee. TelephoneNumber structure.

attributes.name: FreeFormNumber
attributes.description: Specifies the telephone number in free-form. Maximum 30 characters.

fields.name: Mobile
fields.description: Mobile phone number of the employee. TelephoneNumber structure.

attributes.name: FreeFormNumber
attributes.description: Specifies the mobile telephone number in free-form. Maximum 30 characters.

fields.name: BillableTime
fields.description: If true, this employee's time is billable; the duration captured against this employee can be billed to a customer. The default is false.

fields.name: BillRate
fields.description: The wage rate, per hour, billed for this employee's time when BillableTime is true. Specified as a monetary amount. Available when QuickBooks Time/time tracking is enabled.

fields.name: CostRate
fields.description: Pay rate, per hour, of the employee. Specified as a monetary amount.

fields.name: BirthDate
fields.description: Birth date of the employee. Local timezone: YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: Gender
fields.description: Gender of the employee. Supported only when the QuickBooks Payroll feature is enabled.

fields.name: HiredDate
fields.description: Date the employee was hired. Local timezone: YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: ReleasedDate
fields.description: Release date of the employee, i.e., the date employment was terminated. Local timezone: YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: SSN
fields.description: Social Security Number (SSN) of the employee. For US companies. The value is masked in responses; for example, XXX-XX-1234. Input format may include or omit dashes.

fields.name: EmployeeNumber
fields.description: Employee reference number, such as a badge or payroll number, as assigned by the QuickBooks company.

fields.name: EmployeeType
fields.description: The employee type used for payroll classification. Free-form string in QuickBooks Online (the fixed enumeration applies to QuickBooks Desktop only).

fields.name: Organization
fields.description: If true, this entity refers to an organization/company rather than a person. The default is false for an Employee.

fields.name: V4IDPseudonym
fields.description: Pseudonym Id, used internally to associate the Employee object with payroll. System-generated and read-only.

fields.name: MetaData
fields.description: Descriptive information about the object, including create and last-modified timestamps. System-generated.

attributes.name: CreateTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was created in the source domain.

attributes.name: LastUpdatedTime
attributes.description: Time the entity was last updated in the source domain.

fields.name: domain
fields.description: The originating domain of the object. Always QBO for entities created via the API. Internal use, read-only.

fields.name: sparse
fields.description: Indicates whether the response represents a sparse (partial) object. When true, only specified fields were updated. Internal use, read-only.
